evidence.quote: Data quality check: 508 orders with run_date 2026-10-20 have an order_ts outside 2026-10-20 (UTC)
evidence.why: Alert details the exact issue with date consistency and the number of misplaced orders due to timezone differences.
Config specifies local bucket timezone rather than UTC, causing dates to be bucketed incorrectly relative to UTC order_ts.

args.root_cause: The pipeline uses 'bucket_timezone: local' in pipeline.yaml, which buckets orders into run_dates based on local time rather than UTC. This shifts orders whose UTC timestamps fall on a different local calendar day into the run_date bucket for the local date, causing date consistency alerts.
args.suggested_fix: Change bucket_timezone in pipeline.yaml from local to UTC so that run_dates align strictly with UTC order_ts boundaries.
